title: bob findings
description: The complete output of a code review. The reviewer returns this object and posts nothing itself.

summary.description: 2-5 sentences: what the PR does and the overall read. Markdown. Follows the repo's writing style.

suggested_verdict.description: Advisory only — the engine decides the actual verdict.

findings.description: Concrete, actionable findings. Omit cosmetic nitpicks unless they violate a required repo standard.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the changed file. Omit only for repo-wide findings.

line.description: Line number in the NEW file (or old file when side is LEFT). For a range, the LAST line.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range. Omit for single-line.

side.description: RIGHT = added/context line, LEFT = removed line.

severity.description: blocker = bug/regression or a rule the repo says to block on; convention = violates a required repo standard; risk = plausible problem worth confirming; nit = minor; question = needs author input.

body.description: The comment. Explain the problem and the fix. Markdown.

suggestion.description: Optional replacement code for exactly the commented line range. Omit unless it applies cleanly.

intent_note.description: Does the PR do what its linked issue asked? Null when there is no linked issue.

body.description: Markdown: what the issue asked, what the PR does, and any gaps.
